briefings.title: He Helped Create Google Drive. This Is What He’s Building Next.
briefings.tldr: Shan Sinha, Co-Founder and CEO of Canopy and former co-founder of DocVerse (which became Google Drive), discusses his journey of persistence through 60 investor rejections, the critical need to protect healthcare workers from rising workplace violence using wearable technology, and why AI will act as a job creator rather than a disruptor.
